rows.en:
{C:81930B00}{C:81958296500100000000}This is Tsuragi.
Astante II, respond.

{C:81900600}{C:819582961D3200000000}Admiral!
Are you all right?!

{C:81930B00}{C:81958296510100000000}Part of the army has gone underground.
But Binzvanker has taken control
everywhere.

{C:81958296520100000000}Akatsuki, I need you to use all your strength
to retake the cities!

{C:81900700}{C:819582961E3200000000}Do you know
where Binzvanker is?

{C:81930B00}{C:81958296530100000000}{C:819782830400}Rondo{C:819782830000}, is that you?
Probably just where you imagine.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900600}{C:819582961F3200000000}Admiral!
It's no use...

{C:81900400}{C:81958296203200000000}Uncle, where do you think
Binzvanker is?

{C:81900600}{C:81958296213200000000}There, I take it?

{C:81900700}{C:81958296223200000000}Yes.
Where they first deployed
Imakarum in battle.

{C:81958296233200000000}They have other ties
to that place as well.
I can't imagine them being anywhere else.

{C:81908200}{C:81958296243200000000}Then why don't we just
get over there
and attack?

{C:8190C800}{C:81958296263200000000}Naive. It won't be that easy.
They're bound to have
some kind of trap waiting.

{C:8190CE01}{C:81958296273200000000}Then we'll defeat them one by one.
Let's liberate the cities, one at a time.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296283200000000}That sounds best.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296293200000000}{C:819782830300}Astante Fortress{C:819782830000} aside,
our two targets are {C:819782830300}Deon Town{C:819782830000} and
{C:819782830300}Cloud City{C:819782830000}.

{C:81930100}{C:819582962A3200000000}How did you know
Binzvanker was in Astante Fortress,
Rie?

{C:81900400}{C:819582962B3200000000}Honestly.
It's in any reasonably detailed
history book.

{C:81930100}{C:819582962C3200000000}Was it?

{C:81900600}{C:819582962D3200000000}In any case,
it'll be either Deon Town
or Cloud City.



{x00}

How long do you intend
to cling to someone else's dream?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296333200000000}None at the moment.
Except in Cloud City.

{C:81935300}{C:81958296343200000000}Then Cloud City is next.

all the way to a place like this.

{C:81936F00}{C:819582964F3200000000}Then finish your business
and hurry back to that Terra place.

{C:81939B00}{C:81958296503200000000}I'll do just that.

rows.en:
{C:81930D00}{C:81958296643200000000}Why do you think I started these wars?
I knew of the existence of
{C:819782830400}Mediator{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296653200000000}People's hatred, anger, sorrow...
I knew that such intense emotions
would draw the Mediator here.

{C:81958296663200000000}You were delightfully active,
spreading the ravages of war.

{C:81958296673200000000}Thanks to you, I have obtained
this magnificent power!!
Let me show you a glimpse of it.



{x00}

{C:819582966A3200000000}Next, you shall
